headline: Bitcoin Extends Losses as Spot ETF Outflows Hit Crypto Market
summary: Bitcoin dropped for a third consecutive day alongside sliding Asian tech shares, while BlackRock's spot bitcoin ETF recorded its largest single-day outflow since its launch.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, serving as a primary sentiment indicator for digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Prices fell as record daily capital outflows from spot ETFs joined broader technology equity declines.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Institutional capital fled spot ETFs while declining global equity markets weighed on crypto sentiment.
